items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: We had some legendary people in that show. Because there was Johnny Hodgins and there was Eddie Rector.

ctx.x: something great. And I turned around to thank him -- next time I saw him he was dead. But I've never had a chance to thank him for that statement that has been with me and should be with all young musicians. In fact, any line you're in. Don't worry about those that are good. Worry about the bad ones. It's a negative approach, but it's a darned good approach for any youngster coming up in the business. Look for the things that are not right. Then you can say, "Well I'm glad that I saw that. Now I will know not to…

But, getting back to this show. We run this show good. We had some legendary people in that show. Because there was Johnny Hodgins and there was Eddie Rector. Eddie Rector was the man that started this coming out of the trenches and different things. And they used his drill today. He created that drill.
